Stabilo Relax Dryer
International technology partnership

01

Executive Summary

During my Bhatt Bros tenure, I led brand, communications and go-to-market work for textile machinery. We introduced the Stabilo Relax Dryer through the joint venture with Italy’s Alea Impianti Tessili. International exhibitions generated 39 client inquiries from nine countries.

02

The Challenge

Translate technical capabilities and an international technology partnership into a consistent story customers could evaluate. Digital, offline and partner communications needed to support the same commercial direction.

03

The Execution

  1. Modernize the brand

    Led brand strategy and digital transformation across the business.

  2. Explain the partnership

    Connected the Stabilo Relax Dryer introduction with the value of the Indo-Italian joint venture.

  3. Align delivery

    Coordinated Sales, Operations, Logistics and PR around go-to-market work.

  4. Develop new markets

    Delivered integrated regional campaigns and community and partner engagement programs.

04

The Impact

Partnership launch and market-expansion outcomes reported during the Bhatt Bros engagement.
